content.value: Sketch the space curve whose position vector is 4 cos $t \hat { i } + 4 \sin t \hat { j } + 3 t \hat { k }$ . Hence find unit tangent vector $\bar { T }$ and normal vector $\overline { { N } }$ . Also, find the radius of curvature.
